headline: South African Parliament Demands Answers on SAA Financial Crisis
summary: South African lawmakers demanded transparency over state carrier South African Airways' financial records, its competitiveness, and the August National Treasury debt guarantee.
why: South African Airways has repeatedly relied on state guarantees, representing an ongoing fiscal risk factor for South Africa's sovereign budget.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Ongoing financial bailouts and guarantees for state-owned airlines burden South African public finances.
